question: ‘The Race of My Life’ is written by which of the following personalities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Milkha Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Milkha Singh authored the autobiography titled 'The Race of My Life'.
 
• Milkha Singh, also known as the 'Flying Sikh', was an Indian track and field sprinter who was introduced to the sport while serving in the Indian Army.
 
• His autobiography provides insights into his life, his struggles, and his achievements in the field of athletics.
 
• The book also sheds light on his journey from being a victim of the Partition of India to becoming one of the country's most celebrated athletes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Milkha Singh was born on 20th November 1929 in Gobindpura, Punjab, British India.
 
• He represented India in the 1956 Melbourne Olympics, the 1960 Rome Olympics, and the 1964 Tokyo Olympics.
 
• Milkha Singh won gold medals in the 1958 Commonwealth Games and the Asian Games in 1958 and 1962.
 
• His autobiography 'The Race of My Life' was co-authored by his daughter, Sonia Sanwalka.
 
• In 2013, a Bollywood film titled 'Bhaag Milkha Bhaag' was released, which was based on his life and autobiography, with actor Farhan Akhtar portraying Milkha Singh.
